trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I wish I have more money.
trap.right: I wish I had more money.
trap.why: Para desejo irreal no presente, o português usa o subjuntivo (“quem me dera tivesse”). O brasileiro usa o presente; em inglês: wish + passado.

fix.wrong: I wish I would have a car.
fix.right: I wish I had a car.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I don’t have a car.” (I wish…)
rewrite.answer: I wish I had a car.
